1: import { sql, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
2: import type { DrizzleDB } from "../db";
3: import {
4: 	matchPlayer,
5: 	seasonPlayer,
6: 	playerAchievement,
7: 	type achievementType,
8: } from "../db/schema/league-schema";
9: 
10: type AchievementType = (typeof achievementType)[number];
11: 
12: type AchievementQueueMessage = {
13: 	seasonPlayerIds: string[];
14: };
15: 
16: export type { AchievementQueueMessage };
17: 
18: const streakThresholds: Partial<Record<AchievementType, number>> = {
19: 	"5_win_streak": 5,
20: 	"10_win_streak": 10,
21: 	"15_win_streak": 15,
22: 	"3_win_loss_redemption": 3,
23: 	"5_win_loss_redemption": 5,
24: 	"8_win_loss_redemption": 8,
25: 	"5_clean_sheet_streak": 5,
26: 	"10_clean_sheet_streak": 10,
27: 	"15_clean_sheet_streak": 15,
28: 	"3_goals_5_games": 3,
29: 	"5_goals_5_games": 5,
30: 	"8_goals_5_games": 8,
31: };
32: 
33: export async function calculateAchievements(db: DrizzleDB, seasonPlayerIds: string[]) {
34: 	if (seasonPlayerIds.length === 0) return;
35: 
36: 	// Single query: get all match results for all players, ordered by creation time
37: 	const allMatchResults = await db
38: 		.select({
39: 			seasonPlayerId: matchPlayer.seasonPlayerId,
40: 			result: matchPlayer.result,
41: 			homeTeam: matchPlayer.homeTeam,
42: 			matchId: matchPlayer.matchId,
43: 			createdAt: matchPlayer.createdAt,
44: 		})
45: 		.from(matchPlayer)
46: 		.where(inArray(matchPlayer.seasonPlayerId, seasonPlayerIds))
47: 		.orderBy(matchPlayer.createdAt);
48: 
49: 	// Single query: get goals conceded per match for each player
50: 	// Goals conceded = sum of opponent goals in the same match
51: 	// For a home player, conceded goals = match.awayScore; for away player = match.homeScore
52: 	// We can derive this from the match scores via match table
53: 	const matchIds = [...new Set(allMatchResults.map((r) => r.matchId))];
54: 
55: 	const goalsConcededMap = new Map<string, Map<string, number>>();
56: 	if (matchIds.length > 0) {
57: 		const goalsConceded = await db.all<{
58: 			seasonPlayerId: string;
59: 			matchId: string;
60: 			goalsConceded: number;
61: 		}>(sql`
62: 			SELECT 
63: 				mp.season_player_id as seasonPlayerId,
64: 				mp.match_id as matchId,
65: 				CASE WHEN mp.home_team = 1 THEN m.away_score ELSE m.home_score END as goalsConceded
66: 			FROM match_player mp
67: 			INNER JOIN match m ON mp.match_id = m.id
68: 			WHERE mp.season_player_id IN (${sql.join(
69: 				seasonPlayerIds.map((id) => sql`${id}`),
70: 				sql`, `
71: 			)})
72: 		`);
73: 
74: 		for (const row of goalsConceded) {
75: 			let playerMap = goalsConcededMap.get(row.seasonPlayerId);
76: 			if (!playerMap) {
77: 				playerMap = new Map();
78: 				goalsConcededMap.set(row.seasonPlayerId, playerMap);
79: 			}
80: 			playerMap.set(row.matchId, row.goalsConceded);
81: 		}
82: 	}
83: 
84: 	// Single query: get last 5 matches goals scored per player
85: 	// Goals scored for home player = match.homeScore; for away = match.awayScore
86: 	const last5GoalsMap = new Map<string, number[]>();
87: 	if (matchIds.length > 0) {
88: 		const last5Goals = await db.all<{
89: 			seasonPlayerId: string;
90: 			goalsScored: number;
91: 			rn: number;
92: 		}>(sql`
93: 			SELECT seasonPlayerId, goalsScored, rn FROM (
94: 				SELECT 
95: 					mp.season_player_id as seasonPlayerId,
96: 					CASE WHEN mp.home_team = 1 THEN m.home_score ELSE m.away_score END as goalsScored,
97: 					ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mp.season_player_id ORDER BY mp.created_at DESC) as rn
98: 				FROM match_player mp
99: 				INNER JOIN match m ON mp.match_id = m.id
100: 				WHERE mp.season_player_id IN (${sql.join(
101: 					seasonPlayerIds.map((id) => sql`${id}`),
102: 					sql`, `
103: 				)})
104: 			)
105: 			WHERE rn <= 5
106: 			ORDER BY seasonPlayerId, rn
107: 		`);
108: 
109: 		for (const row of last5Goals) {
110: 			let goals = last5GoalsMap.get(row.seasonPlayerId);
111: 			if (!goals) {
112: 				goals = [];
113: 				last5GoalsMap.set(row.seasonPlayerId, goals);
114: 			}
115: 			goals.push(row.goalsScored);
116: 		}
117: 	}
118: 
119: 	// Resolve seasonPlayerId -> playerId for achievement storage
120: 	const playerIdMap = await db
121: 		.select({
122: 			seasonPlayerId: seasonPlayer.id,
123: 			playerId: seasonPlayer.playerId,
124: 		})
125: 		.from(seasonPlayer)
126: 		.where(inArray(seasonPlayer.id, seasonPlayerIds));
127: 
128: 	const seasonToPlayerMap = new Map(playerIdMap.map((p) => [p.seasonPlayerId, p.playerId]));
129: 
130: 	// Group match results by season player
131: 	const resultsByPlayer = new Map<string, typeof allMatchResults>();
132: 	for (const r of allMatchResults) {
133: 		let playerResults = resultsByPlayer.get(r.seasonPlayerId);
134: 		if (!playerResults) {
135: 			playerResults = [];
136: 			resultsByPlayer.set(r.seasonPlayerId, playerResults);
137: 		}
138: 		playerResults.push(r);
139: 	}
140: 
141: 	// Calculate achievements per player
142: 	const achievementsToInsert: { playerId: string; type: AchievementType }[] = [];
143: 
144: 	for (const spId of seasonPlayerIds) {
145: 		const playerId = seasonToPlayerMap.get(spId);
146: 		if (!playerId) continue;
147: 
148: 		const earned: AchievementType[] = [];
149: 		const matches = resultsByPlayer.get(spId) || [];
150: 		const concededForPlayer = goalsConcededMap.get(spId) || new Map();
151: 
152: 		// Check redemption achievements (pattern matching on result string)
153: 		checkRedemptionAchievements(earned, matches);
154: 
155: 		// Check goals scored in last 5 games
156: 		const lastFiveGoals = last5GoalsMap.get(spId) || [];
157: 		checkGoalsScoredStreak(earned, lastFiveGoals);
158: 
159: 		// Check win streaks and clean sheet streaks
160: 		let currentWinStreak = 0;
161: 		let currentCleanSheetStreak = 0;
162: 
163: 		for (const m of matches) {
164: 			if (m.result === "W") {
165: 				currentWinStreak++;
166: 			} else {
167: 				currentWinStreak = 0;
168: 			}
169: 
170: 			checkStreakAchievement(earned, currentWinStreak, [
171: 				"5_win_streak",
172: 				"10_win_streak",
173: 				"15_win_streak",
174: 			]);
175: 
176: 			const goalsConceded = concededForPlayer.get(m.matchId) ?? -1;
177: 			if (goalsConceded === 0) {
178: 				currentCleanSheetStreak++;
179: 				checkStreakAchievement(earned, currentCleanSheetStreak, [
180: 					"5_clean_sheet_streak",
181: 					"10_clean_sheet_streak",
182: 					"15_clean_sheet_streak",
183: 				]);
184: 			} else {
185: 				currentCleanSheetStreak = 0;
186: 			}
187: 		}
188: 
189: 		for (const achievement of earned) {
190: 			achievementsToInsert.push({ playerId, type: achievement });
191: 		}
192: 	}
193: 
194: 	// Batch insert all achievements (idempotent via onConflictDoNothing)
195: 	if (achievementsToInsert.length > 0) {
196: 		const now = new Date();
197: 		await db
198: 			.insert(playerAchievement)
199: 			.values(
200: 				achievementsToInsert.map((a) => ({
201: 					id: crypto.randomUUID(),
202: 					playerId: a.playerId,
203: 					type: a.type,
204: 					createdAt: now,
205: 					updatedAt: now,
206: 				}))
207: 			)
208: 			.onConflictDoNothing();
209: 	}
210: }
211: 
212: function checkGoalsScoredStreak(earned: AchievementType[], lastFiveGoals: number[]) {
213: 	if (lastFiveGoals.length < 5) return;
214: 
215: 	if (lastFiveGoals.every((n) => n >= 8)) {
216: 		earned.push("8_goals_5_games", "5_goals_5_games", "3_goals_5_games");
217: 	} else if (lastFiveGoals.every((n) => n >= 5)) {
218: 		earned.push("5_goals_5_games", "3_goals_5_games");
219: 	} else if (lastFiveGoals.every((n) => n >= 3)) {
220: 		earned.push("3_goals_5_games");
221: 	}
222: }
223: 
224: function checkStreakAchievement(
225: 	earned: AchievementType[],
226: 	currentStreak: number,
227: 	streakAchievements: AchievementType[]
228: ) {
229: 	for (const achievement of streakAchievements) {
230: 		if (currentStreak === streakThresholds[achievement] && !earned.includes(achievement)) {
231: 			earned.push(achievement);
232: 		}
233: 	}
234: }
235: 
236: function checkRedemptionAchievements(earned: AchievementType[], matches: { result: string }[]) {
237: 	const resultString = matches.map((m) => m.result).join("");
238: 
239: 	const redemptionAchievements: AchievementType[] = [
240: 		"3_win_loss_redemption",
241: 		"5_win_loss_redemption",
242: 		"8_win_loss_redemption",
243: 	];
244: 
245: 	for (const achievement of redemptionAchievements) {
246: 		const count = streakThresholds[achievement];
247: 		if (!count) continue;
248: 		// Pattern: N consecutive losses followed by N consecutive wins
249: 		const pattern = "L".repeat(count) + "W".repeat(count);
250: 		if (resultString.includes(pattern)) {
251: 			earned.push(achievement);
252: 		}
253: 	}
254: }
